about: Every model and texture the kit carries: the built-in library (MODEL_LIBRARY, TEXTURE_LIBRARY, in pixel-engine.js) and the imported packs (packs/<id>.json, load with loadPack). Filter on kind, family, pack and tags; search id, about and tags. Place a library model with buildModel(id); a pack model with buildModel(id, { catalog: await loadPack(pack) }).
